hypothesis: The graph-cut partitioner's swap-gain is computed with unweighted adjacency, so timing-critical cut edges cost the same as non-critical ones; feeding the graph builder's edge weights (criticality) into the adjacency used by `_compute_swap_gain` and `_compute_cut_weight` will bias the partition toward keeping critical nets intra-tier, reducing cross-tier detours and TNS.
expected_effect: TNS improves modestly across all circuits (fewer critical cross-tier nets); WNS small improvement; overflow unchanged or slightly better; runtime unchanged.
